applicable: Hump Ridge precedent: Green Gully Track and the Gibraltar-Washpool walk are kept and held for a route-midpoint pin, not dropped.
Pipiriki/gateway-journey benchmark: Walcha, Barraba, Nundle and Bingara (draw lies beyond the town) are sent to review, not placed; Ebor village was rejected (gateway to Ebor Falls, which is kept).
Ohakune Carrot precedent: The Big Lamb (Guyra) is kept as a roadside icon and placed in Armidale's span.
Ninety Mile Beach precedent (long feature not under its neighbour): Wollomombi and Apsley go to Oxley Wild Rivers, not the nearby city; Kwiambal/Warrabah, reached on their own, stand alone.
Operator/vehicle test: no vehicle or operator kept; Tamworth Country Music Festival rejected as an annual event, as the negative benchmarks require.
